ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Nov-15-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing on Name Change. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Patrick Heard. Petitioner Emmanuel Chuidian was sworn and examined. Good cause appearing, the Court grants the Decree changing name to John Vincent Sotto Chuidian. Decree signed in open court.
